sheet.content:
## Key definitions
- **Data communication**: exchange of data between two devices over a transmission medium [p. 1]
- **Network**: set of devices connected by communication links to share data and resources [p. 1]
- **PAN**: Personal Area Network, devices around one person, e.g. Bluetooth earphones [p. 1]
- **LAN**: Local Area Network, one building or campus, high speed, owned privately [p. 1]
- **OSI model**: seven-layer model from ISO, each layer offers services to the layer above it [p. 2]
- **TCP/IP model**: four-layer model for the Internet, Network access (link), Internet (IP, ARP, ICMP), Transport (TCP, UDP), Application (HTTP, DNS, SMTP, FTP) [p. 2]
- **Network topology**: physical or logical arrangement of devices in a network [p. 2]

## Diagrams to draw
- **Network topology**: Bus, Star
- **OSI model**: seven stacked boxes for sender and receiver, data going down one stack, across the medium and up the other [p. 2]

## Formulas and code
None in this unit

## Must remember
- **Data communication components**: message, sender, receiver, transmission medium, protocol [p. 1]
- **Network criteria**: performance, reliability, security [p. 1]
- **Network devices**: switch, bridge, router, gateway [p. 2]
- **Network topology**: Bus, Star
- **OSI model layers**: Physical, Data link, Network, Transport, Application [p. 2]
